content_sections.heading: Bengaluru Rural District Court Stenographer Grade-III Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 21 posts of Stenographer Grade-III are to be filled, comprising 4 backlog posts and 17 new posts. Since this recruitment is for a single post category with reservation-wise distribution, the vacancy break-up is shown below. Note: The backlog posts reserved for disabled candidates under SC and Category-2A are earmarked for the visually impaired category. If eligible visually impaired candidates are not available in that category, other disabled candidates of the same category, or other eligible candidates of the same category, will be considered as per Government Order No. SISHNu 02 SeHaM 2023 dated 08.03.2023. Note: The Scheduled Caste (Category-C) post is reserved for candidates belonging to the 59 most backward castes within that category. If eligible candidates from these 59 castes are not available, other eligible caste candidates within Category-C will be considered as per Government Order No. SIASHE 02 SeHaM 2026 dated 13.05.2026. Note: Within the General Merit new posts, 1 post is reserved for persons with blindness or low vision, under roster point 4, as per the disability classification for these posts.

content_sections.heading: Bengaluru Rural District Court Stenographer Grade-III Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed the 2nd PUC (12th standard) examination, or possess a 3-year diploma in Commercial Practice, or hold an equivalent qualification. Candidates must have passed Senior Grade Shorthand and Typewriting examinations in both Kannada and English languages conducted by the Department of Public Instruction, or hold an equivalent recognised qualification. Basic computer knowledge relevant to office work is compulsory. An additional age relaxation of 5 years is applicable, as a one-time measure for all categories in this recruitment, as per Government Order No. SIASHE 262 SeNeNi 2025 dated 29.01.2026. Further age relaxation is also available for candidates already in government service, widows, ex-servicemen, and persons with disabilities, as per the Karnataka Civil Services (General Recruitment) Rules, 1977.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Bengaluru Rural District Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: bengalururural.dcourts.gov.in/online-recruitment Register and fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and category-related details. Upload a recent passport-size photograph (in .jpg format, not exceeding 50 KB), signed in blue ink, without any editing. Upload a scanned signature made with a black ballpoint pen on white paper (in .jpg format, not exceeding 25 KB). Pay the applicable application fee online through Net Banking, Credit/Debit Card, UPI, or QR Code. Verify all entered details carefully before final submission, as no correction requests will be entertained after submission. Submit the application and download/save the online application copy and fee payment receipt for future reference. Candidates should note that only one application can be submitted per candidate. If more than one application is submitted, only the last submitted application will be considered, and no request for change will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Bengaluru Rural District Court Stenographer Grade-III Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a Skill Test (Shorthand and Typing) followed by document verification/interview, as detailed below: Candidates will be dictated a passage at 120 words per minute for 5 minutes each in Kannada and English shorthand at the time of the skill test. Candidates must transcribe the dictated passage using a computer within 45 minutes. Transcripts are checked using computer software. A minimum of 100 marks is fixed for each of the Kannada and English language skill tests, and candidates must secure at least 50 marks in each to qualify. Candidates who qualify the skill test are shortlisted for interview/document verification based on total marks, in a ratio of 1:5 per post (i.e., the top 5 candidates per vacancy). Final selection is based on the total marks scored in the skill test and document verification/interview.

content_sections.heading: Probation Period
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of 2 years, as per the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977. During the probation period, candidates must pass the prescribed departmental examinations, the Kannada language examination, and the computer literacy examination applicable to the post.

content_sections.heading: Bengaluru Rural District Court Stenographer Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: Candidates must produce the following original documents (along with copies) at the time of the skill test, interview, or document verification: Printout copy of the online submitted application Copy of the fee payment receipt Proof of date of birth (SSLC marks card / birth certificate) Educational qualification proof (PUC/Diploma marks cards, Senior Grade Shorthand and Typewriting certificates in Kannada and English) Caste certificates for SC/ST/Category candidates, as applicable Certificates for Rural, Kannada medium, Ex-servicemen, Persons with Disabilities, Project-displaced, or Third Gender candidates, wherever applicable Rural reservation candidates: prescribed form endorsed by the concerned field education officer Disability reservation: medical certificate in the prescribed format as per the Government Order dated 19.11.2005 Age relaxation proof for widows, retrenched employees, and similarly eligible candidates, issued by a competent authority Ex-servicemen: discharge/release certificate Character certificates issued by two responsible district-level persons, obtained within 6 months prior to the last date of application, and a conduct certificate from the institution last attended No Objection Certificate for candidates already in government service, as per Karnataka Government Notification dated 12.10.2022, to be submitted within 30 days of selection Valid original photo identity proof (Voter ID/Aadhaar Card/Driving Licence/PAN Card/Passport) at the time of the skill test and interview
